notes: bot v6: candidate fallthrough — the submit/poll flow now walks a RANKED candidate list (scoreItem score descending, backend newest-first order breaks ties, deduped by ref, non-novel only, quark-preferred pool as before) and tries up to 3 candidates: a candidate whose source share was cancelled by its owner (backend terminal status dead_source), that fails or is blocked, that finishes without a share link (done_pending_share), or whose poll times out is silently skipped for the next candidate; the group only ever sees the single initial searching message plus the final outcome (the link, or one 'the sources we found are no good, some links are dead' reply when all tried candidates fail). Production trigger 2026-11-01 00:50: the top-scored source for a search had been cancelled by its owner (Quark error 41012), the transfer silently produced nothing, and the old single-candidate flow misleadingly reported 'already transferred, but no new link was generated' instead of trying the next of ~40 candidates. The my_share instant-reply path and the all-novel reply run before the loop, unchanged; a content-filtered submit still stops the flow immediately. scripts stays v4: stop and OTA bot-restart sweep /proc by exact argv (watchdogs first, TERM then KILL) and kill orphaned bot.js processes that pidfiles/process groups miss; the updater sweeps, then relaunches exactly one watchdog. bot also keeps v5 behaviors (empty-search retry: up to 2 re-runs at ~6s gaps before declaring not-found; 21:00-23:59 Asia/Shanghai digest poster polling the release mirrors for digest/digest-YYYY-MM-DD.txt, posted once per date to group 873487569 under a marker file) and v4 behaviors (single-instance lock + message_id dedup + video-over-novel pick).
